project_overview.architecture_pattern: Monolithic Multi-Agent System with Networked Database

test_requirements.testing_philosophy: Test each code chunk before moving to next chunk. 100% test pass required.
testing_levels: Unit tests for each code chunk (45 chunks = 45 test suites)
Integration tests for each dependency level (5 levels)
Database tests for all CRUD operations

unit_tests.description: Create unit tests for each of 45 code chunks
requirements: Each chunk must have corresponding test file
Test all functions in the chunk
Test happy path and error cases
Test edge cases and boundary conditions
Mock external dependencies (database, API calls, file I/O)

integration_tests.description: Create integration tests for each dependency level
requirements: Test interaction between chunks within same level
Use test database for integration tests

end_to_end_tests.description: Create E2E tests for complete workflows

requirements: Test CRUD operations for all entities
Test page processing time (target: < 15 seconds per page)

steps: Verify final result or graceful failure
scenario_1_ocr_retry.expected_outcome: OCR succeeds on attempt 2 or 3, or returns best attempt result

scenario_2_semantic_splitting.expected_outcome: Text split into appropriate 3-5 line chunks with >80% confidence

scenario_3_pause_resume.expected_outcome: Processing resumes exactly from page 25, no data loss

steps: Edit attribute 5 key name from 'Keywords' to 'Tags'
Verify verification UI shows new label 'Tags'
Attempt to edit attribute 1 (should fail - system-defined)
scenario_4_attribute_editing.expected_outcome: Attributes 2-30 editable, attribute 1 locked, UI reflects changes

steps: Create two knowledge units with low confidence (<70%)
Verify one record deleted, other updated
Verify checkpoint event received at page 50
scenario_6_websocket_updates.expected_outcome: WebSocket delivers updates reliably, no missed events

scenario_7_image_extraction.description: Test image extraction and AI description
steps: Process page with 3 images (diagram, chart, photo)
scenario_7_image_extraction.expected_outcome: All images extracted, described, compressed, stored

steps: Process page with 5 knowledge units and 1 image
Verify coordinates match knowledge unit positions
Verify rectangle data stored in JSON format
scenario_8_marker_generation.expected_outcome: Marked image has correct rectangles, visually accurate

steps: Verify language detected as 'arabic', OCR uses 'ara' model
scenario_9_bilingual_support.expected_outcome: Language detection accurate, OCR uses correct model

steps: Verify status set to 'completed' after page 10
Verify no errors for remaining 90 pages
scenario_10_partial_processing.expected_outcome: Only first 10 pages processed, clean completion

test_execution_order.phase_1_unit_tests: Run unit tests for each chunk as it's implemented (chunk-by-chunk)
test_execution_order.phase_2_integration_tests: Run integration tests after each level complete
test_execution_order.phase_3_e2e_tests: Run E2E tests after Level 4 complete
test_execution_order.phase_4_performance_tests: Run performance tests after all functionality working

special_testing_notes.note_1: Tests must be runnable BEFORE development starts (test-first approach)
special_testing_notes.note_2: Each chunk test must be independent and isolated
special_testing_notes.note_3: Use test database (knowledge_extraction_test) for all DB tests
special_testing_notes.note_4: Mock external dependencies (Tesseract, AI models) for speed
special_testing_notes.note_5: Create sample PDFs with known content for predictable testing
special_testing_notes.note_6: WebSocket tests require async test support
special_testing_notes.note_7: Performance tests should have reasonable thresholds
special_testing_notes.note_8: Database tests should clean up after themselves (rollback)
special_testing_notes.note_9: OCR tests require actual Tesseract installation
special_testing_notes.note_10: AI model tests can use mock responses for speed

success_criteria.test_generation_complete: All 45 chunk tests + integration + E2E tests created
success_criteria.test_documentation_complete: Test plan and coverage matrix documented
success_criteria.fixtures_ready: Sample PDFs and mock data created
success_criteria.runnable: All tests can run with 'pytest' command
success_criteria.developer_ready: Tests provide clear success/failure criteria for each chunk

next_phase.developer_workflow: For each chunk: Implement code → Run chunk tests → All tests pass → Move to next chunk
